capabilities: Color a tag from its right-click menu
Pick a palette color or any custom color
Reset a tag to its default look
Manage the palette and colored tags in settings
extras: Works on mobile with a long-press instead of a right-click; tags colored here keep their color while other tags keep an automatic coloring plugin's colors.
problem: Coloring individual tags in Obsidian otherwise needs CSS snippets or an automatic scheme that colors every tag the same way.

relations.evidence: Using an automatic tag-coloring plugin such as Colored Tags? Keep it.

summary: Adds a right-click menu item that assigns a palette or custom color to any tag, in notes, reading view, query results and Properties.
